results.answer:
Your tailored dress should arrive in about **11 to 13 working days**.

- Delivery to Kosovo takes 4 to 6 working days [1][2].
- Custom tailoring adds 7 working days to the delivery time [3][4].

If you placed your order after 14:00, it ships the next working day [2], so that day may not count toward the estimate. You'll receive a tracking number by email on the day it ships [2].

The sources don't say whether the 7 days of tailoring start counting before or after that next-day shipping rule, so I can't give an exact date.
